description: This file implements the main front-end React component for the 'App' page in a Next.js project, specifically handling the flow for uploading documents, managing persona data, orchestrating backend API calls for persona generation and finalization, and rendering the multi-step UI for the persona creation workflow.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: Type defining the current state of the application workflow ('initial', 'processing', 'draft', 'finalized').

classes.name: Experience
classes.description: Interface representing a person's professional experience, including job title, company, dates, and description.

classes.name: CareerHighlight
classes.description: Interface for capturing key career highlights with optional source information.

classes.name: PersonaData
classes.description: Interface modeling the user persona, including personal info, skills, experiences, education, certifications, tools, industries, years of experience, and career highlights.

methods.name: uploadCategoryLabel
methods.description: Converts an upload category enum into a human-readable label.

methods.name: uploadCategoryHelperText
methods.description: Provides helper text for each upload category.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Normalizes any value into a string array, filtering out non-strings.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-null, non-empty object.

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Returns initials or a placeholder for a display label based on input string.

methods.name: getNestedOrchestrationValue
methods.description: Safely accesses nested properties of orchestration response objects, returning value and path used.

methods.name: logAvailableKeys
methods.description: Logs keys available in orchestration response objects for debugging shape mismatches.

methods.name: extractPersonaJsonFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts persona JSON payload and its source path from orchestration response objects, prioritizing expected fields.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Maps backend persona JSON into the UI's PersonaData shape, performing fallback and string conversions.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component managing document uploads, persona data, orchestration API calls, workflow steps, and UI rendering for persona creation process.
